references.text: Joseph's descendants complain that they have received only one share, which Joshua answers in verse 17
Joshua continues his answer to Joseph's descendants and promises them the hill country
Describes the inheritance of Joseph's sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, whom Joshua addresses here
Jacob adopts Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, which explains why they are counted as two tribes
Jacob's blessing over Joseph, promising great blessing to his descendants
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Joseph, describing their multitude and strength
The census shows that Ephraim and Manasseh were numerous tribes
